g.text: Opaque on Ethereum: every signature FORS+C, private by default
Live on Sepolia and the EIP-8141 devnet · ETHGlobal Mumbai · opaque.credit
Path A · EIP-8141 devnet · one frame transaction (type 0x06)
SENDER · Uniswap v4 swap through the PQ hook
SENDER · deposit into a privacy pool
SENDER · rotate to the next key
no bundler, no paymaster: the account pays for itself
Path B · Sepolia · one ERC-4337 UserOperation
one executeBatch: send · swap · claim a name ·
deposit · a dapp's call approved in Opaque
keys hand over to the next before they run out
the attester is a FORS+C account
in: any wallet · out: FORS+C only
every name, pool, hook and the vault answer to the same FORS+C key format
EF anon-rpc (Nox mixnet): reads and UserOperations,
the payee or a one-time account
PQ AUTH CORE · PQKeyRegistry + ForsVerifier / LeanFors
one FORS+C key format for accounts, names, LP guards and the vault · few-time keys, the next one committed ahead · hash-based: nothing for Shor's algorithm to attack
